name: Softly
author: denonmaryland
description: Tap a key, speak, tap again: local Whisper dictation through Voxtype with a quiet backlit pill, plus a bar popover for sounds, vocabulary, recent transcripts and status.

schema.label: Dictation key
schema.description: Hyprland key name such as F9 or SUPER + H. Applied by Set up in the panel; F9 replaces Omarchy's stock Voxtype binding.
